findings.problem: der Kram is just as common and informal as a one-word singular for stuff, and the hint only rules out Sachen, so Kram would also be a right answer.
findings.fix: hint: informal, one singular word, not Sachen or Kram

note: The plural null is correct, since Zeuge as a plural of this word only turns up in technical senses, and cosa-thing is not a match, since thing is countable and stuff is not.
